correctness.rationale: The deterministic identity P=W-3T reduces the joint covariance to triangle-wedge and triangle-triangle overlap classes. Exactly three potential wedges share two edges with each triangle, 6(n-3) share one, and the rest share none; exactly 3(n-3) other triangles share an edge. Substituting edge-presence q_j=p^j or (m)_j/(N)_j and simplifying yields both claimed expressions; the fixed-m polynomial and denominators have the stated signs. All 33,856 graphs on n=4,5,6 and further rational parameters through n=60 passed 775 separate exact assertions in standalone verification. Finite data alone would not prove the all-n claim; the combinatorial computation and factorization do.

value.rationale: Induced open two-paths and triangles constitute two fundamental undirected three-node motif classes used in graphlet/triad census comparisons. The exact transition from positive to negative association as independent-edge density changes, contrasted with universal negative covariance under a fixed edge count, identifies a mathematically meaningful ensemble sensitivity, with distinct n^4 and n^3 dense fluctuation scales. This is not a routine marginal count or arbitrary finite slice; it distinguishes standard null-model interpretations for joint motif enrichment.
